messages:
lina: Quick update: rolling out smart-sampler-prefetch v1.0 to canary (eng-runtime). Early numbers look solid for short- and medium-chat workloads.
omar: Sweet. can we see the bench output?
lina: pasted from the quick harness (chat-short seq=48, chat-med seq=128):
```
Benchmark: chat-short (seq=48)
Baseline    p50=12.0ms  p95=49.0ms  cost=0.118 units
SmartSampler v1 p50=8.6ms  p95=45.2ms  cost=0.095 units  (-19.5% cost)

Benchmark: chat-med (seq=128)
Baseline    p50=33.5ms  p95=118.4ms cost=0.352 units
SmartSampler v1 p50=30.9ms p95=116.9ms cost=0.330 units  (-6.3% cost)
```
evan: Nice p50 wins, solid cost delta. Any changes to KV hit-rate or backend tokens?
lina: KV-prefix hit improved by ~3.7pp on canary, backend token count down ~10% on short workload. CPU on canary nodes +2.1%, mem neutral. No cold-start regressions observed.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started for smart-sampler-prefetch v1.0 (4% us-west) :rocket:
perf-bot: quick regression scan running — no alerts in first 12m. :white_check_mark:
finance-bot: Lina — finance would like per-tenant cost deltas for the first 24h, please tag the job.
lina: On it. I'll kick off per-tenant diff and post results to #finance in ~45m.
omar: Is this runtime-only or kernel-level?
lina: Runtime-only changes. Introduced a probabilistic sampler for prefix prefetch and a short adaptive buffer that avoids redundant KV lookups. No CUDA/driver changes.
action: lina flipped config on canary:
```yaml
enable_smart_sampler_prefetch: true
sampler_prob_threshold: 0.32
adaptive_buffer_ms: 7
coalesce_hint: 14
```
nadir: Rollout gates? what's the plan?
lina: Plan: 4% -> 25% at T+2h -> 60% at T+8h -> 100% at T+36h if all gates clear. Gate: p99 >6% regression OR error-rate >0.5% -> immediate rollback. Also auto-rollback healthcheck tied to p99.
evan: Ops note — watch the sampler dashboard and the backend-token panel. I added shortlinks to #oncall: https://console.redwood/perf/smart-sampler
perf-bot: regression-check completed — no regressions in the last 30m window. :white_check_mark:
lina: Thanks team. Will post the 2-hour checkpoint with per-tenant deltas. Small change, decent latency + cost win for interactive chat. :party:
